overview_description.description:
Scratchpad is a workspace built for sales to update Salesforce and take sales notes and daily todos.

The software can be installed as a Google Chrome plugin or as a web application. It connects to Salesforce and provides an interface where sales professionals can keep all their notes, process workflows, spreadsheets, and tasks. Scratchpad is backed by Accel, Craft Ventures, Sound Ventures, and Shrug Capital.

Co-founders Pouyan Salehi and Cyrus Karbassiyoon started the company in San Francisco, California in 2019.
